name: privacy-guard
description: Before a Write or Edit, checks the content Claude adds for real-looking personal and health data (SSNs, payment cards, IBANs, medical record numbers, named people beside diagnoses) and blocks high-severity values, with notes for the rest. Known test values pass.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Turn the personal and health data check on or off.

configFile.title: Project config file
configFile.description: JSON file, relative to the project, whose keys override these options (enabled, mode, blockAt, noteAt, publicContacts, allowDomains, ignore).

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: block refuses writes with high-severity values; warn only adds notes.

publicContacts.title: Public contacts
publicContacts.description: Comma-separated email addresses and phone numbers meant to be public, never flagged.
